transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I came in because I just can’t seem to keep my mind on things the way I used to. I work as a credit counselor, and lately, I'll just stare at a loan worksheet or a client follow-up list and reread the same line over and over. Then I end up putting off making my calls because... well, even simple decisions just feel a lot harder than they should right now.
Have you been feeling sad or down lately?

Yes, I have. Most days, there’s just this... dull heaviness sitting with me. Even when I’m at the community center or out in my garden—places that really used to lift me up—I feel like I’m just going through the motions. It's like I just have a smile pasted on for everyone else, but that heavy feeling is still right there underneath it all.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Well, it's been quite a while. Um, I'd say this has really been going on since my close friend passed away. That was a little over two years ago now.
Have you experienced any loss of interest in activities you normally enjoy?

No, not really. I still do the things I usually do. Like I mentioned, I still go to the community center and work in my garden. I haven't lost interest in them, it's just... I just don't feel that same lift from them right now. But I still want to do them.
Have you experienced any changes in your appetite or sleep patterns lately?

No, I can't say that I have. My appetite has been pretty much the same as always. And my sleep... well, I sleep about as well as I usually do. I haven't noticed any real changes with either of those things.
Have you been feeling more tired than usual lately?

Yes, I definitely have. Even if I get a full night of sleep, I still wake up tired. And then... well, by the time I've done a couple of client calls for work, or just gone out and watered the tomatoes, my body feels like I've put in a whole day already. It's just very draining.
Have you been feeling guilty or worthless about anything lately?

No, I don't think so. I haven't done anything to feel guilty about, really. And... well, I don't feel worthless. I know I still do good work for my clients, helping them sort out their credit and loans. So, no, I haven't been having thoughts like that.
Do you feel like these feelings of sadness and heaviness are interfering with your daily life most of the time?

Yes, I think they are. I mean, at work, I've started postponing my client follow-ups at the credit office. It's just... harder to get to them right now. And in my personal life, I've stepped back from the gallery events and the walking-club outings I used to make a point of attending. So, yes, it's definitely having an impact on my day-to-day routine.
Would you say these feelings of sadness and heaviness are present every day?

Yes, I'd say it's most days. There is just this... dull heaviness sitting with me. Even when I'm at the community center or out working in my garden—places that really used to lift my spirits—I just feel like I'm going through the motions now. It's like I just have a smile pasted on, but underneath, that heaviness is always there.
How many months have you been feeling this way, with the dull heaviness and difficulty making decisions?
Well, it's been a lot longer than a few months, actually. This has all been going on since my close friend died... that was a little over two years ago now.
Have you experienced any periods of at least two months where you didn't feel this way since your friend passed away?

No, I haven't. I don't think there's been any stretch like that. I mean, maybe a day or two here and there where things feel a little lighter, but definitely not two whole months. It's just been pretty constant ever since she passed.
